items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Mathy' only in a note by the interviewer. The interviewee's response discusses meeting 'Big Matlock' in a music store, with no mention of Mathy.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Well, see, with musicians it's always been all right, you know. It was just the other people, you know.

Now, I remember the first time I got turned on was Big Matlock [Big Matlock] turned me on, you know. And do you know how we met? In the music store. And everybody... Well, he was the first one that played the... First he had the play the record of Louis ...(?)..., and I can play the song to this day. We were in this music store in Omaha, Nebraska, with that show, that TOBA show there... He heard us humming the thing, and he said, "Are you guys musicians?" "Yeah."
